info.name: Relay Chat API
info.description:
# Relay Chat API

Postman collection for **Relay**, a real-time chat backend.

- **Base URL:** `https://relay-7sl3.onrender.com` (collection variable `baseUrl`)
- **REST endpoints:** registration, login, user listing, sending a message and conversation history.
- **Real-time messaging:** STOMP over WebSocket (documented below; it cannot be run from this collection).

## How to use

1. Run **Authentication > Register** (once per account), or skip it if the account already exists.
2. Run **Authentication > Login**. Its test script stores the returned JWT in the collection variable `token`.
3. Run the requests in **Users** and **Messaging**. They send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically.

Register and Login override the collection's authentication with **No Auth**. All other requests inherit the Bearer token. Example credentials are placeholders only; never commit real passwords or tokens.

## Real-time WebSocket messaging (STOMP)

A Postman Collection v2.1 file holds REST requests only, so the WebSocket workflow is documented here instead of being faked as a REST request. Use a STOMP client to try it.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| WebSocket endpoint | `wss://relay-7sl3.onrender.com/ws` |
| Protocol | STOMP over WebSocket |
| Authentication | Native header on the STOMP `CONNECT` frame: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>` |
| Subscribe to | `/user/queue/messages` |
| Send to | `/app/chat.send` |

**Send body (JSON):**

```json
{
  "receiverId": 2,
  "content": "Hello in real time!"
}
```

**Frame sequence:**

1. Open a WebSocket to `/ws`.
2. Send a `CONNECT` frame with the `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>` header (get the JWT from **Login**).
3. Send a `SUBSCRIBE` frame for `/user/queue/messages`.
4. Send a `SEND` frame to `/app/chat.send` with the JSON body above.

The saved message is delivered to both the recipient's subscription and the sender's subscription. Delivered messages use the same fields as the REST message response: `id`, `senderId`, `receiverId`, `content`, `createdAt`. The format of WebSocket error frames is unspecified.

## Unspecified details

Success status codes for the messaging endpoints, the `createdAt` format, the JWT lifetime and error response formats are not specified in this documentation. The saved examples show illustrative values only.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Account creation and login. Neither request requires authentication.

exec: pm.test('Response contains id, name, email and message', function () {

request.description:
Creates a new user account.

**Authentication:** not required.

**Request body (JSON):** `name`, `email`, `password`.

**Success status:** `201 Created`

**Success response fields:** `id`, `name`, `email`, `message`.

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Relay User One",
  "email": "user1@example.com",
  "message": "<message text>"
}
```

The exact value of `message` and the format of error responses are unspecified. The example credentials are placeholders; use your own.

request.description:
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT.

**Authentication:** not required.

**Request body (JSON):** `email`, `password`.

**Success status:** `200 OK`

**Success response:**
```json
{
  "token": "<JWT_TOKEN>"
}
```

**Test script:** on success, the `token` value is saved to the collection variable `token`, which every protected request uses as its Bearer token. The JWT lifetime and the format of error responses are unspecified.

item.name: Users
item.description: User discovery. Requires a Bearer token.

request.description:
Lists all users except the currently authenticated user.

**Authentication:** required. Bearer token from the collection variable `token` (run **Login** first).

**Success status:** `200 OK`

**Success response:** a JSON array. Each element has `id`, `name`, `email`.

```json
[
  {
    "id": 2,
    "name": "Relay User Two",
    "email": "user2@example.com"
  }
]
```

The format of error responses is unspecified.

item.name: Messaging
item.description: REST messaging and conversation history. Requires a Bearer token. For real-time messaging see the collection description.

exec: pm.test('Response contains id, senderId, receiverId, content and createdAt', function () {

request.description:
Sends a text message to another user over REST.

**Authentication:** required. Bearer token from the collection variable `token`.

**Request body (JSON):** `receiverId` (numeric ID of the recipient, from **List users**) and `content`.

**Success response fields:** `id`, `senderId`, `receiverId`, `content`, `createdAt`.

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "senderId": 1,
  "receiverId": 2,
  "content": "Hello from Relay!",
  "createdAt": "<timestamp>"
}
```

The success status code, the `createdAt` format and the format of error responses are unspecified. Change `receiverId` to the ID of a user that exists in your database.

request.description:
Retrieves the conversation history between the authenticated user and another user.

**Authentication:** required. Bearer token from the collection variable `token`.

**Path variable:** `userId`, the other user's numeric ID. Edit it in the **Params** tab.

**Success response:** a JSON array of message objects, each with `id`, `senderId`, `receiverId`, `content`, `createdAt`.

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "senderId": 1,
    "receiverId": 2,
    "content": "Hello from Relay!",
    "createdAt": "<timestamp>"
  }
]
```

The success status code, the `createdAt` format and the format of error responses are unspecified.
